IL = timezone(timedelta(hours=3))
NOW = datetime(2026,8,26,21,50, tzinfo=IL)
CUTOFF = datetime(2026,8,25,21,50, tzinfo=IL)

WATCH = ["DeItaone","WalterBloomberg","LiveSquawk","unusual_whales","zabormetrics","CNBCOvertime","jimcramer","CarterBWorth","chaikinadvisor","StockMKTNewz","guraborisov","markminervini","WillMeade","TrendSpider","OptionsPlay","Stocktwits","MarketRebels","traborisov","IncredibleTrade","ripaborisov"]

        dt=datetime.fromtimestamp(ms/1000, tz=timezone.utc).astimezone(IL)
        chunk=m.group(0)
        tm=re.search(r'full_text:"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"', chunk)
        text=''
        if tm:
            try: text=tm.group(1).encode('utf-8').decode('unicode_escape')
            except: text=tm.group(1)
        is_rt='retweeted_status' in chunk
        out.append((dt, is_rt, text.replace('\n',' / ')[:100]))
    return out

print('=== WATCHLIST LAST ORIGINAL (skip pinned if first is much older; skip RTs) ===')

    raw=open(path,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()

        ft=re.search(r'full_text:"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"', head)
        text=''
        if ft:
            try: text=ft.group(1).encode('utf-8').decode('unicode_escape')
            except: text=ft.group(1)

        ft_pos=head.find('full_text:')
        rt_pos=head.find('retweeted_status')
